title: Add GitHub release environment initializer
summary: Add a dry-run-first helper for preparing GitHub beta/stable release environments and checking required signing/updater secret names.
reason: The beta workflow can be dispatched only after GitHub environments and protected release secrets are prepared. Operators need a repeatable setup command that is safe by default and explicit when applying external GitHub changes.
behavior_before: Operators had setup and dispatch preflights, but no helper to create/check beta-release and stable-release environments or report missing environment secret names.
behavior_after: Operators can dry-run the GitHub environment setup commands, then explicitly apply environment creation and required secret-name checks through GitHub CLI.
manual_validation: Initialize-PrivateBetaGitHubReleaseSetup.ps1 dry-run - passed and printed environment/secret setup commands
git diff --check targeted GitHub release initializer files - passed
pytest private beta GitHub release setup/setup/dispatch tooling suite - passed (7 passed)

rollback_plan: Remove the GitHub release environment initializer script, tests, docs references, generated summaries, and this change packet.
notes: The initializer defaults to dry-run and must not create GitHub environments unless -Apply is passed. It never prints or writes secret values.
